limitations: Direct retained registrar is protected; core plugins.add destruction rejection policy is unchanged.
Per artifact: six real-core registration tests and 36 native resource/pixel tests with controlled hosts.
Existing callback-less Windows WebKit first two pixel cells remain diagnostic; no full pixel or physical device acceptance.
New test is wired into installed roster, but this turn used rebuilt bundles rather than a new installed tarball. Older installed maps are stale after this source change.
